stable.notes: Fix Desktop 2.2 Dashboard crash caused by a missing time import when saving vacancy snapshots. The release pipeline now runs a dashboard-persistence smoke test before building and publishing.

beta.notes: Fix Jobs.cz microsite email autofill by adding semantic email-field detection using labels, placeholders, aria metadata and nearby field text. Diagnostics now include the email field source. Manual queue behavior and manual final Submit safety remain unchanged.
